verdict.rationale: The Jobs v2 read endpoint documents a format parameter that returns the transcript as srt, vtt, or webvtt instead of the default JSON, so captions can be exported directly through the API. The MCP server also offers a 'subtitles' prompt template. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SRT/VTT output, and documentation of caption formatting details such as cue length or line-breaking controls.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export a transcript as SRT or VTT captions through the API or a documented path

citations.quote: The desired format for the transcription output. Valid options are srt, vtt, or webvtt. If not provided, the output will be in JSON format.
This endpoint allows you to check the status of an existing transcription job and retrieve its results if available.
